timeline.body: Cloudflare is investigating issues with some firewall configuration updates. Customers making changes to Custom Lists and User Agent Blocking rules, may experience configuration delays applying to the edge. We are working to analyze and mitigate this problem. More updates to follow shortly.
timeline.label: investigating

timeline.body: The issue has been identified and a fix is being implemented.
timeline.label: identified

timeline.body: A fix has been implemented and we are monitoring the results.
